items.title: Introduction to R for Data Science (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Introduction to R for Data Science' under topic 6.10 (PDF 89, printed 85).

blocks.text: R data analysis ki programming language hai jo research (tehqeeq) mein bohat istemal hoti hai. Is mein data ko dikhane ke liye mazboot graphical tools (graph banane ke tools) hain. R bare datasets ko achhi tarah sambhalti hai, aur is ke bohat se packages (tayyar code ke majmue) data science ke kaam karte hain. R seekhne se analysis ki salahiyat barhti hai jo machine learning ki bunyad mein kaam aati hai.
